speaker: Damián
cn: （笑）妈，这礼物是我给你买的，你看看喜不喜欢。
en: (laughs) Mom, I've bought this gift for you—come take a look, do you like it?

speaker: Beatriz
en: (Happy) Thank you so much!

speaker: Beatriz
cn: （喜）好漂亮啊，你比你爸会哄人。
en: (Happy) It’s gorgeous! You’re much better at charming women than your dad is.

speaker: Samanta(OS)
cn: 妈，你竟然被一条项链收买了。
en: Mom, seriously? One necklace and he’s already won you over?

speaker: Damián
en: Samanta, this is for you.

speaker: Damián
en: (Happy) Wifey, you're back!

speaker: Beatriz
en: Isadora, look at the necklace Damián bought me!

speaker: Isadora
en: (laughs) It looks great!

speaker: 同学一（OS）
cn: Damián明天我们有个同学聚会，你可一定要来啊！Serafina也会来，吃的还是高档饭店，你要是不来，说不定这辈子都吃不上这样的菜了！
en: Damián, we’ve got a class reunion tomorrow. You’d better show up! Serafina’s coming too, and we’ve booked a really fancy restaurant. If you don’t come, you might never get another chance to enjoy food that expensive!

speaker: Damián
cn: （勾起嘴角）好啊，我一定准时到。
en: (Smiling) Alright, I'll definitely be there on time!

speaker: Damián
en: Come with me.

speaker: Isadora
en: (frowning) What is it? Why all the secrecy?

speaker: Damián
en: Follow me.

speaker: Isadora
en: (with a sour expression) What are you doing?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （挑眉）我哪有那么无聊，又不是小女生了。
en: (raises an eyebrow) I’m not that childish. I’m not some teenage girl anymore.

speaker: Damián
en: (Happy) Ta-da! Beautiful flowers for my beautiful wifey!

speaker: Isadora
cn: （笑）真当我是小女孩，用鲜花骗我？
en: (laughs) You really think I’m some little girl you can win over with flowers?

speaker: Damián
en: Look here.

speaker: Isadora
en: (with a secret smile) What's that?

speaker: Damián
cn: （给Isadora戴戒指）我们都结婚了，给你买戒指很合理吧。（看Isadora戴戒指的手）很合适。
en: (Wears a ring on Isadora's finger)
